resources.name: ABINIT

access.notes: Open-source DFT package; version 8.10.1 recommended. Can be installed via package managers (e.g., conda).

resources.notes: Required for all DFT calculations (relaxations, energy evaluations).

resources.name: JTH PAW pseudopotentials for Be

access.notes: Publicly available JTH atomic data for beryllium. The specific Be PAW file is part of the table.

resources.notes: Required for PAW calculations in ABINIT.

resources.name: OVITO

access.notes: Optional visualization and analysis tool for structural identification (hcp fraction).

resources.notes: Optional; the core scored artifacts can be produced using ABINIT alone, but OVITO facilitates adaptive common neighbor analysis and strain visualization.
